title: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month
headline: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month
ai_overview: Tidal is officially banning AI-generated music on December 9th. As a result of this change, Tidal will delete around 29 million AI-generated songs and reject an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day, according to Tidal music lead Robert Andersen.
